newsitem.title: TURKEY: Amex issues first Turkish lira credit cards.
newsitem.headline: Amex issues first Turkish lira credit cards.

text.p: American Express Co announced its first Turkish lira-denominated cards in Turkey through its Turkish partner Akbank under an independent operating agreement signed between two companies early this year.

Harvey Golub, chairman of the company, said green and gold American Express cards would be available in late October in Turkey, where dollar-denominated Amex cards were previously issued by various other local banks.
"We are very optimistic about the Turkish market in the long term," he told a news conference during the announcement in Istanbul late on Wednesday.
He said they had chosen Akbank, a leading commercial bank in Turkey, as part of their strategy to expand partnerships in the emerging markets.
There are some 2.5 million credit cards, mostly Visa, in Turkey with an annual turnover of $3 billion, and the number of cards is expected to swell three to four times in five to eight years.
